trainingPlanCategory.description: Observed: FBT_ADAPTIVE (Garmin Run Coach adaptive plan).

endDate.description: Consumed by sync_training_plan to skip already-ended plans. Matches the account's target race date on this plan.

statusKey.description: Observed: Scheduled (for the currently-active plan, despite the name).

taskList.description: Consumed by sync_training_plan, filtered to today..+TRAINING_PLAN_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS by calendarDate.

calendarDate.description: Consumed as the point's date/time. Plain YYYY-MM-DD, unlike taskWorkout.scheduledDate.

taskWorkout.description: Present (non-null) even on rest days — restDay:true with workoutName/estimatedDurationInSecs/etc. all null in that case.

workoutId.description: Observed always null here — same as get_scheduled_workouts's calendarItems for fbtAdaptiveWorkout items.

workoutName.description: Consumed as name. Observed: "Base", "Tempo", "Long Run". Null on rest days.

workoutDescription.description: Consumed as description. The actual pace/HR target, e.g. "137bpm" (HR-capped base run) or "21:00@5:10/km" (tempo segment length + pace). Null on rest days.

scheduledDate.description: Not consumed — calendarDate (one level up) is used instead; this is a datetime not a date.

estimatedDurationInSecs.description: Consumed as duration_s. This is the real duration get_scheduled_workouts's calendarItems.duration always has null.

workoutUuid.description: Not consumed. Does NOT match the workoutUuid on the same calendarDate's get_scheduled_workouts calendarItem — the plan regenerates day to day, so these aren't stable join keys across syncs.

trainingEffectLabel.description: Not consumed. Observed: AEROBIC_BASE, TEMPO, INVALID (on rest days).

workoutPhrase.description: Consumed as workout_phrase. Observed: HIGH_RECOVERY_TIME_BASE, BASE, TEMPO, LONG_WORKOUT, TRAINING_READINESS_REST (adaptive rest day inserted in response to a low Garmin readiness score).

restDay.description: Consumed as rest_day (stored as 1.0/0.0 — InfluxDB line protocol field, not a tag).

adaptivePlanPhases.description: Consumed by sync_training_plan to derive each task's phase field (date-range lookup, not per-task on the API side). Observed phases in order: BASE, BUILD, PEAK, TAPER, TARGET_EVENT_DAY. Each entry's startDate/endDate are plain YYYY-MM-DD.

planPhases.description: Observed identical in content to adaptivePlanPhases in this account's captured sample. Not consumed — adaptivePlanPhases is used instead.

ownerId.description: Account identifier — do not log or commit raw captures containing this.

title: Adaptive training plan detail (get_adaptive_training_plan_by_id)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_adaptive_training_plan_by_id(plan_id), where plan_id comes from get_training_plans()'s trainingPlanList. Consumed by sync_training_plan, which writes one training_plan_task point per taskList entry within today..+14 days, including rest days (which have no corresponding entry at all in get_scheduled_workouts's calendarItems).

Verified against: one active FBT_ADAPTIVE (Garmin Run Coach) plan, 2026-08-03, trainingPlanId 46457367 — a mix of rest, base, tempo, and long-run task entries across the current week. No fixture yet for a non-adaptive (manually-built) training plan, or a plan with taskNote/grouped entries populated.
